title: Anyone else?
content: I’ve had a few dreams that were in an actual mall with living spaces inside and working places, however 98% of them are out in the open and I don’t access them through a “mall”. When I view these places (which I can resonate with a lot of descriptions/pictures) it’s from the outside and not within an internal structure. I wonder if anyone else is the same way? For me it’s not all connected it’s in various places and various locations, similar to the real world.
